ارتقبتم (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَبْتُمْ (irtaqabtum) /ir.ta.qab.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# اُرْتُقِبْتُمْ (urtuqibtum) /ur.tu.qib.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
